title: Usssh!
desc: A film crew arrives at a secluded estate to shoot their movie, only to encounter eerie supernatural forces. Later, the estate owner's brother-in-law vanishes without a trace.

title: Kotigobba - 2
desc: While searching for a criminal who robs wealthy business tycoons after dark, the police come across an estate agent who reveals that he has a brother who looks like him.

title: Apthamitra
desc: Ramesh and Ganga, a married couple, buy a palatial house, which is home to a vengeful spirit. When Ganga accidentally sets the spirit free, mysterious incidents start taking place in their household.

title: Jagamalla
desc: Thooku Durai, a strong and respected village leader, faces personal struggles as he tries to reunite with his estranged wife Niranjana and daughter, all while confronting challenges from his past.

title: Anjaniputra
desc: A businessman saves a policeman from a group of thugs. As a result, he incurs the wrath of a ruthless local gangster who is also an assassin.

title: Myna
desc: Born into a life of hardship, Myna faces familial and financial struggles. Subsequently, she leaves her home to carve a better future, fighting against all odds for her family's sake.
